test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A alone can do a work in 30 days, B alone in 40 days. They start together, but A leaves 5 days before the completion.

Total work is completed in 18 days. How many days did A work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time taken to complete the work = 18 days.

A leaves 5 days before the completion of the work.

Number of days A worked = Total completion time − Days A was absent.

Number of days A worked = 18 − 5 = 13 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 13 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **A** = 30 days

Time taken by **B** = 40 days

Total time for completion = 18 days

**A** leaves 5 days before completion

⇒ Total Work = LCM of 30 and 40 = 120 units

⇒ Efficiency of A = 120 ÷ 30 = 4 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of B = 120 ÷ 40 = 3 units/day

⇒ Total duration of the work = 18 days

⇒ A left 5 days before the completion of the work

⇒ Days A worked = 18 − 5 = 13 days

**∴ The correct answer is 13 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the actual work done by each individual (Efficiency × Time).

Pipes and Cisterns

This concept follows the same logic as Time and Work, where an inlet pipe does positive work and an outlet pipe does negative work.

Alternate Day Work

When individuals work on alternate days, the work is calculated in cycles (e.g., a 2-day cycle for two people).
